headline: Thailand Holds Interest Rates at 1% Amid Weak Growth and Inflation Risks
summary: Thailand's central bank maintained its benchmark interest rate at 1.0% as economic growth remains subdued and inflationary pressures persist.
why: Monetary policy settings in emerging Asian economies balance domestic recovery needs against external capital flow volatility.

impacts.name: Thailand
impacts.why: Maintaining benchmark rates supports domestic credit conditions while dampening growth momentum.
